  "plan": "# Convert Tests to unittest Format\n\n**Goal:** Rewrite the four modules in `tests/` as standard-library `unittest` so they run via `python -m unittest` (and still via pytest discovery if desired).\n\n**Architecture:** Keep one test module per concern. Map each pytest function to a `TestCase` method; replace fixtures with `setUp`/`tearDown` (or `addCleanup`); replace `assert`/`pytest.raises` with `self.assert*`; replace `monkeypatch`/`tmp_path` with `unittest.mock.patch` and `tempfile.TemporaryDirectory`.\n\n**Tech stack:** `unittest`, `unittest.mock`, `tempfile`, `pathlib` (no new deps). Leave `pytest` in `[tool.uv] dev-dependencies` unchanged unless you later decide to drop it.\n\n## Files to modify\n\n- [tests/test_console_output_shutdown.py](tests/test_console_output_shutdown.py) — fixture → `setUp`/`tearDown`\n- [tests/test_live_log_csv.py](tests/test_live_log_csv.py) — `tmp_path` → `TemporaryDirectory`\n- [tests/test_recording_auto_start_settings.py](tests/test_recording_auto_start_settings.py) — `monkeypatch`/`tmp_path` → `patch` + temp dir\n- [tests/test_xdf_completeness.py](tests/test_xdf_completeness.py) — fixture + `pytest.raises` → `setUp`/`tearDown` + `assertRaises`\n\n## Conversion rules (apply everywhere)\n\n| Pytest idiom | unittest equivalent |\n|---|---|\n| `def test_foo():` | `class TestFoo(unittest.TestCase):` + `def test_foo(self):` |\n| `assert x == y` | `self.assertEqual(x, y)` |\n| `assert x is True/False` | `self.assertTrue` / `self.assertFalse` |\n| `assert x is not None` | `self.assertIsNotNone(x)` |\n| `assert a \u003c b` | `self.assertLess(a, b)` |\n| `assert item in seq` | `self.assertIn(item, seq)` |\n| `pytest.raises(E)` | `with self.assertRaises(E):` |\n| `@pytest.fixture` + yield | `setUp` / `tearDown` (or `addCleanup`) |\n| `tmp_path` | `tempfile.TemporaryDirectory` in `setUp`, store `Path` on `self` |\n| `monkeypatch.setattr(mod, name, val)` | `unittest.mock.patch.object(mod, name, val)` as context or `addCleanup` |\n| module `if __name__` | add `unittest.main()` at bottom of each file |\n\nKeep helper functions (`_wait_for`, `_bare_app`) as module-level helpers. Keep docstrings. Drop `import pytest` once unused. Remove clearly unused imports in `test_xdf_completeness.py` (`sys`, `threading`, `MagicMock`, `patch` if still unused after conversion).\n\n---\n\n### Task 1: `test_console_output_shutdown.py`\n\n**Replace** `console_frame` fixture with a `TestCase` that owns the Tk root/frame:\n\n```python\nimport unittest\n# ...existing imports without pytest...\n\nclass TestConsoleOutputShutdown(unittest.TestCase):\n    def setUp(self):\n        self.root = tk.Tk()\n        self.root.withdraw()\n        self.frame = ConsoleOutputFrame(\n            self.root, self.root,\n            capture_stdout=False, capture_stderr=False,\n            initial_visible=False, pass_through=False,\n        )\n\n    def tearDown(self):\n        try:\n            self.frame.restore_streams()\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n        self.root.destroy()\n```\n\n- Methods that used `console_frame`: use `self.root` / `self.frame`.\n- `test_on_closing_restores_console_before_stop_work`: no fixture needed; use `self.assertLess(restore_idx, stop_transcription_idx)` (and same for recording).\n- Threading / deadlock test: swap bare `assert` for `self.assertTrue` / `self.assertFalse`.\n\n---\n\n### Task 2: `test_live_log_csv.py`\n\n- Class `TestLiveLogCsv` for path helper + writer tests.\n- In each test that needs a temp dir (or in `setUp`):\n\n```python\nself._tmpdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()\nself.addCleanup(self._tmpdir.cleanup)\ntmp_path = Path(self._tmpdir.name)\n```\n\n- Replace all `assert` with `self.assertEqual` / `self.assertTrue` / `self.assertIn` / `self.assertNotIn`.\n- Keep `_wait_for` unchanged; assert on its return value with `self.assertTrue(...)`.\n\n---\n\n### Task 3: `test_recording_auto_start_settings.py`\n\n- Class `TestRecordingAutoStartSettings`.\n- Keep `_bare_app()`.\n- For load/save tests that patched `_RECORDING_SETTINGS_FILE`:\n\n```python\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:\n    settings_file = Path(td) / \"recording_settings.json\"\n    with patch.object(logger_app_mod, \"_RECORDING_SETTINGS_FILE\", settings_file):\n        # ... same body ...\n```\n\n- Tests without filesystem stay simple method tests with `self.assertEqual` / `self.assertTrue` / `self.assertFalse`.\n\n---\n\n### Task 4: `test_xdf_completeness.py`\n\n- Class `TestXdfCompleteness`.\n- Replace `temp_xdf_dir` fixture:\n\n```python\ndef setUp(self):\n    self._tmpdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()\n    self.temp_xdf_dir = self._tmpdir.name\n\ndef tearDown(self):\n    self._tmpdir.cleanup()\n```\n\n- `pytest.raises(RuntimeError)` → `with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):`.\n- Rest of bodies stay the same aside from assertion API swaps.\n- Clean unused imports.\n\n---\n\n### Task 5: Verify\n\nRun both discovery styles (unittest is the success criterion):\n\n```bash\npython -m unittest discover -s tests -v\n```\n\nOptionally: `pytest tests/ -v` (pytest can still collect `TestCase` subclasses).\n\nExpected: all converted tests collect and pass (XDF tests may be slow / environment-dependent; do not change their logic).\n\nNo commits unless requested.\n",
